topics.name: Exploring effects and impact (fiction and imaginative writing)

connections.why: Reading non-fiction for information builds the analytical foundation extended to the subtler effects of fiction and imaginative writing
Communicating information clearly to a reader mirrors the clarity and structure demanded by a spoken presentation
Awareness of how language creates impact informs the rhetorical and expressive choices made in speech
